Once it is added, get "PhoneCam" in AltStore.

If the QR code does not work, you can also install PhoneCam.ipa directly. Shift-click the AltServer icon > "Sideload .ipa..." > choose the saved PhoneCam.ipa. (With this method you reinstall the app yourself to update it.)
If "AltServer.ServerError 2005" appears during installation, "Refresh" AltStore once in AltStore's "My Apps", then install again.

setup.wizard.setupwizard__page_welcome_2:
We will check the software needed to use your iPhone as an OBS camera. Anything already installed is skipped.
Visual C++ and camera registration are installed automatically (you will see one administrator prompt).
For iTunes, iCloud, AltServer and VB-CABLE, we open the official installer and guide you through each button to press.
After that, we also guide you through installing PhoneCam on your iPhone.

wireless.firewall: Allow Wi-Fi connections in PhoneCam on your iPhone and choose Scan QR code in Settings. If Windows Firewall prompts you, allow access on a trusted network.
wireless.forget_ask: Remove the pairing for "{name}"? Next time you will need to enter the pairing code again.
wireless.hotspot_ok: The hotspot is on. Connect your iPhone to that Wi-Fi network
wireless.hotspot_steps:
1. Turn on the Windows mobile hotspot with the button below.
2. Connect the iPhone to that Wi-Fi network.
wireless.manual_go: Connect with this IP and code
wireless.method_hint: Leave this on Automatic unless you need to.
wireless.qr_error: Could not show the QR code. Check the network connection.
wireless.qr_hint: Just scan a QR code to pair. Starting here is the easiest way.
wireless.rename_label: Name for this iPhone (saved on this PC only)
wireless.scan_error: Could not search for devices. You can enter the IP address manually.
wireless.tether_ok: Connected to the iPhone's Personal Hotspot
wireless.tether_steps:
1. On the iPhone, turn on Personal Hotspot in Settings.
2. On the PC, pick that iPhone in the Wi-Fi list.
wireless.timeout: Still waiting for a connection. If this Wi-Fi network blocks communication between devices, try iPhone Personal Hotspot or your PC mobile hotspot.
